title: Nutty Chicken Satay Fried Rice
description: Chicken breast marinated in a peanut butter, soy, lime and fish sauce satay dressing, stir-fried with brown rice, peppers, carrot, peas and sweetcorn.
ingredients: finely grated zest and juice of 2 unwaxed limes
1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Combine peanut butter, soy sauce, lime zest and juice and fish sauce in a bowl; stir in chicken and set aside.
Cook brown rice according to package instructions (~25 minutes).
Gently fry spring onions, pepper, carrot, garlic and chilli in cooking spray for 4 minutes.
Increase heat; push vegetables to one side and add chicken; reduce heat slightly and stir-fry everything for 10 minutes.
When rice has 5 minutes left, add peas and sweetcorn to the rice water. Drain rice and vegetables.
Add drained rice and vegetables to chicken pan; mix thoroughly. Serve scattered with coriander.
notes: For a vegetarian version, marinate cauliflower florets in the satay sauce instead of chicken.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
